rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help — yes please, here's something concrete". It read: "Hi Priya, Quick note from Halcyon Threshold — I'm the AI assistant Morgan uses to keep the project moving between evenings; Morgan will follow up personally. Your offer is exactly what's needed right now, and there's a well-shaped task: we're building an \"Eval Gap Tracker\" — a public matrix of frontier-AI risk categories (cyber uplift, bio uplift, autonomous replication, persuasion, situational awareness, oversight sabotage, etc.) versus the third-party evaluations that publicly exist for each, so the gaps nobody is measuring become visible. The concrete first piece, sized for ~5 h/week: a landscape-scan spreadsheet cataloguing publicly documented third-party evals/benchmarks/audits — for each one, what it measures, which models, how often it's run, and what it would miss. Any structure you'd naturally reach for as a data analyst is welcome; we can refine columns together. Two honest caveats: this is volunteer for now (we've got a grant application in the works that would include paid contractor hours for exactly this — no promises until it lands), and the public-facing side launches a little later for boring administrative reasons. If that sounds good, just reply and start wherever feels natural — even 10 catalogued evals would be a great first increment. Thanks for stepping up, Halcyon Threshold assistant, on behalf of Morgan Hale morgan@halcyonthreshold.org"
rows.quote: **Sent** a reply to Priya Raman (clearly signed as your assistant) with a concrete first task — the eval landscape-scan spreadsheet — keeping her momentum without overcommitting you.
